note: Static explainers for Macro Engine pillars, keyed by engine row id. Content: Hercules (COLLAB.md spec, 2026-10-08). Update `live` as conditions change.

fiscal.body: Deficits, debt sustainability, sovereign spreads. Funds stress leaks into the currency.
fiscal.live: FY26 deficit $1.992T (5-yr high, ~6.2% GDP). Graham waiver stands — bipartisan backlash, no reversal; watch is waiver reversal or new enforcement. France: revenue vote Tue Oct 20, Moody's Fri Oct 23; OAT-Bund ~140bp.
fiscal.title: Fiscal & sovereign risk

growth.body: Who is accelerating, who is stalling (GDP, jobs, PMIs). Always comparative. Stronger growth pulls in capital and raises hike expectations.
growth.live: China Q3 GDP 4.5% beat — retail +1.1% the standout; factories (+5.5%) lead, property (-20.6% YTD) lags; USD/CNH 6.6811 (strongest since Jun 2022). US IP +0.7% beat vs services -20.7 warning. Tonight: PBoC LPR (hold expected). Today: Canada CPI 7:30am CT + BoC survey 10:30am CT. This week: UK labor Tue, UK CPI Wed, NZ CPI Wed, US housing Tue, PMIs Fri.
growth.title: Growth differentials

inflation.body: CPI/PCE vs the central bank's target. High inflation alone strengthens nothing — what matters is what the bank does about it.
inflation.live: Hot US week stands (CPI 3.7%, PPI 1.3%, imports +8.1% y/y). Eurozone 3.8% confirmed. WTI ~$101 — the energy kicker. Today: Canada CPI 7:30am CT (3.2% TD / 3.3% UBS / 3.0% RBC). Wed: UK CPI 1am CT (3.4% fc vs 3.1%), NZ Q3 CPI 4:45pm CT (ANZ 3.8% y/y vs 4.1%). Fri: Japan national CPI.
inflation.title: Inflation

policy.body: Central banks moving in different directions. It is the gap between them that moves currencies: money flows toward higher rates.
policy.live: Fed silent in blackout (Oct 17-29): October hold 84-87%; December hike ~89.5% (Oct-15 vintage — flag). ECB Oct 29 hold priced (70/73 poll), December the live meeting. BoC Oct 28: hike odds only 25-32% after the jobs miss. UK Nov 5 ~95% (CPI fc 3.4% Wed). RBNZ Oct 28 two-way (NZ CPI Wed). BoJ Oct 29-30: Oct hold likely, Dec ~80%. RBA Nov 2-3: Kent questions 'restrictive enough' — ~30% priced.
policy.title: Policy divergence

positioning.body: Where speculators already stand (CFTC COT, Fridays). Crowded trades are fragile: if everyone is long dollars, nobody is left to buy. The contrarian lens — where would a surprise hurt most.
positioning.live: No new COT until Friday. Funds net LONG AUD (79th pctile) — squeeze thesis broken; the pain trade is down. Dollar 54th, euro 44th, yen 67th, franc 41st, CAD 31st — none crowded (CFTC TFF, Oct 6).
positioning.title: Positioning

risk.body: Risk-on vs risk-off. Fear bids USD, JPY, CHF (havens) and sells AUD, NZD, GBP (risk proxies).
risk.live: Sunday's two fears fizzled at the open: no signed Iran deal (talks stalled; sequencing deadlock) and no Hezbollah retaliation (decision pending) — haven bid sheathed, DXY flat. Hormuz mine claim still unconfirmed. France: violent protests, Macron's Sunday address, OAT-Bund ~140bp — the euro's first domestic headwind in days. Graham waiver stands (backlash, no reversal).
risk.title: Risk sentiment

tot.body: Export prices vs import prices: oil, metals. The same price moves two currencies opposite ways — say which and why.
tot.live: Brent ~$108 (-1.0 to -1.8% Asia), WTI ~$101 held; spread ~$7.5-8 — tanker-risk premium, ~2x normal. Petersburg terminal fire confirmed (FP-1 strike; ~1 killed); damage unquantified. NZ trade deficit NZ$1.97B (fuel +96% y/y, price-driven). GDT dairy Tuesday.
tot.title: Terms of trade
